card.name: Digits inside longer numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, most often 1, 2, 3 or 8, in the middle of a multi-digit code or decimal number. It appears in imprint codes, legal section numbers, catalog references and decimal volumes or doses.

modes.label: Codes and section numbers
modes.description: A digit inside an identifier such as an imprint, order number, legal section or manuscript number.
modes.example: Section 660<<2>>(b) of the Pollution Prevention Act states

modes.label: Decimal amounts
modes.description: The digit after the decimal point in a volume or dose such as 2.2 mL.
modes.example: Reconstitute each single-dose vial of ARCALYST with 2.<<3>> mL of preservative-free Sterile Water
